name: Morikuro Musashi
source:
Side character of episode 2
Working as a medical doctor, Musashi's main responsibility is to further examine the "infected persons"' corpses biologically.
He also provides medical treatment for [spoiler][url=/c92658]Chisa[/url] and [url=/c92657]Kirina[/url] after their 4-year surviving together in a cave.[/spoiler]
